sources.snippet: AstroBridge Version: 0.3.3 — Live Catalog Lookup, Multi-Catalog AI Identification, 261 Tests AstroBridge is an astronomical source matching and cross-catalog identification pipeline. You give it an object name or sky coordinates; it fans out to real catalogs (SIMBAD, NED, Gaia DR3, 2MASS), merges the results, and optionally generates a plain-language description using an LLM.
